The '''Hollastin Run''' was a branching [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It began at [[Circumtore/Legends|Circumtore]], and passed&mdash;from [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] west to east&mdash;[[Affavan]], [[Hollastin]], [[Aylayl]], [[Tsyk]], and [[Unagin]] before terminating at [[Syvris/Legends|Syvris]].
